notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
1. Added keys description interface

2. Optimize object collision logic.

3. Fixed a bug in text display.

notes.title: Version 1.0
notes.content:
Early Access End, thank you for your support.

1. Now you can also encounter monsters during the day.

2. Now cow will drop meat after death.

3. It is now possible to return to the space station from the spacecraft on the planet.

notes.title: Beta 0.9 Update
notes.content:
The beta version is coming to an end.

1. Added placement effects and destruction effects.

2. Added a chainsaw animation.

3. Replaced the new font.

notes.title: Beta 0.8 Update
notes.content:
1. The Creative Mode is now added, when the survival days is greater than 2, it will automatically unlock.

2. Optimized the rock collision body.

notes.title: Beta 0.7 Update
notes.content:
A pet system has now been added.

The offensive monster has a chance to drop the meat that can be fed. After the meat is fed to the little creature 5 times, it will become your pet. Currently you can have up to 3 pets.

notes.title: Beta 0.6 Update
notes.content:
1. Add new building item: road signs.

2. Increase the hp of the monster slightly.

3. Rearrange all the items in the store.

4. Optimize the rock collision body.

notes.title: Beta 0.50 Update
notes.content:
1, Added a new building item, glass wall.

2, The interior of the car is completely open, and now the rear door of the car can be opened.

3, Now the chair can sit down and the bed can lie down.

4, The rover now has a headlight.

5, Now when the number of days of survival is >20 days, there is a 33% chance that the monster will not attack the core at night.

6, Added GUI size adjustment options.

7, GUI optimization.

8, Item description optimization.

9, Grass optimization.

notes.title: Beta 0.40 Update
notes.content:
1. Added a new building item: wall bed.

2. Guli can now follow the player.

3. The item "Case" can now be superimposed.

4. Performance optimization.

notes.title: Beta 0.30 Update
notes.content:
1. A new decorative item "Case" has been added.

2. The global leaderboard viewing feature has been added.

3. The function of automatic long-time aiming has been added (press the middle mouse button).

4. It is now possible to select the quantity when purchasing the seed.

5. Now the stairs can be connected to the side of the other stairs.

6. Death will now be punished and the alive days will be reduced by one day.

7. The weather system will stop running after the core is destroyed.

8. The speed of the rover has now increased.

9. The air wall is added to the edge of the sea floor.

10. The signal tower will now rotate automatically.

11. The street light changes from green to white.

notes.title: Beta 0.20 Update
notes.content:
1, Added a new building: Super Transmission Pipeline.

2, Added a new flying monster.

3, Now the stair can be connected to the side of the foundation.

4, Now the wall and floor can be connected to the underside of the wall.

5, Now the wall can be connected to the underside of the floor.

6, There are now more trees near the spaceship.

7, optimize control, now you can open the store even in the build mode.

8, The assault rifle adds an aiming action.

9, greatly reduced the hp of Kun cattle.

10, Added a mouse icon.

11, Added English translation.

12, Added new footstep sound effects.

13, Updated the building description.

14, Switching weapons in the build mode now automatically cancels the build mode.

15, now the mouse side button can control the character walking.

notes.title: Beta 0.10 Update
notes.content:
1. Wildlife can now be encountered in most areas of the land.

2. The price of seeds is reduced by 20%.

3. The recovery effect of plants is increased by 50%.

notes.title: [Update 0.45] English is now supported !
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33820181/3e5f665081605eaec734500d6e1b31f9d4e392f0.png

Since I am developing this game alone, and my English is not very good, the quality of English translation may not be very high.

If you find a translation error, please let me know and help me correct it.


Update 0.45

1.Add experimental English translation.

2. Add the monster blood bar UI.

3. The flashlight is changed to white, and the range is expanded by 20%.
